units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1">Lev. R. s. 1</cite> <he>אין גנאי … נַקְדּוּדוֹ</he> it is not beneath a king’s dignity to speak with his herder (the Lord spoke to Noah).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:13">Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 8:54">I Kings VIII, 54</cite>) <he>כגין הדין נקדים היה עומד</he> (Var. <cite ref="N01248"><he>נקריס</he></cite>; corr. acc.) Solomon stood before the Lord like a herder (giving an account of the Temple expenses), expl. by R. El. bar A. <he>ככפים הללו וכ׳</he>.
